pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions, primarily four-to-six sided with rounded vertices. The pixel gradients at the edges are smooth and diffuse rather than sharp. Patches on the upper dorsal region exhibit higher pigment density compared to the lower flank where contrast is reduced.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent (Y-shaped). The pathways show consistent pixel thickness across the mid-flank, widening slightly as they descend toward the ventral region.
